sloka: गिरि दुर्गात् विनिष्क्रम्य संविवेश आश्रमम् सुखी ।ततो रामः तु विजयी पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः ॥३-३०-३८॥
transliteration: giri durgāt viniṣkramya saṁviveśa āśramam sukhī ।tato rāmaḥ tu vijayī pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ ॥3-30-38॥

translations.english: Then victorious Rama having been worshipped by the seers and also by Lakshmana entered the hermitage.
